pulse.text: **Quiet three hours — nothing shipped since Gemini Robotics 2**, but Google's next Gemini Pro repriced hard the other way: Polymarket's Aug 14 leg jumped to **49% from 41%** and Aug 21 to 66%, with Aug 31 at 76%, erasing the first-ever downtick recorded last sweep. Traders also marked up how strong it will land — the Arena-debut book now gives **37% to a 1500+ Elo debut, up from 22%**, and 16% to 1510+ from 7%. The language leaderboard is untouched, **Claude Opus 5 at 61** on the Artificial Analysis Index ahead of GPT-5.6 Sol at 59 and Kimi K3 at 57, and Anthropic's July best-model title resolves at noon today at **99.8% on $8.20M** of volume. Anthropic's own next Mythos-class model eased to 71% by Sep 30 with the August leg down to 34% from 37%, while GPT-6 stayed flat at 89% by Dec 31 for a fifth straight sweep. Off the leaderboard the story is price: **OpenAI's 80% cut on GPT-5.6 Luna to $0.20/$1.20** lands the same week CNBC reports Chinese open-weight models undercutting US labs across Asian enterprise demand. Watch the Aug 14 Gemini leg — it is now the only near-term market with real movement in it.
